name: Criticize
overview: Scripture teaches that criticism should be approached with humility, gentleness, and wisdom to avoid stirring anger or causing harm. A soft answer can defuse wrath, while harsh words provoke it, highlighting the power of speech to either heal or wound (Proverbs 15:1, 15:4). Believers are called to exercise discretion by patiently overlooking offenses rather than judging others harshly, recognizing that judging condemns oneself since all are guilty of sin (Proverbs 19:11; Romans 2:1). Furthermore, Christians are encouraged to support the weak and give generously, reflecting Christ’s example rather than focusing on fault-finding (Acts 20:35).
